newsitem.title: USA: ONBANCorp says claims are without merit.
newsitem.headline: ONBANCorp says claims are without merit.

text.p: ONBANCorp Inc said Wednesday its board of directors has determined that a demand made by shareholder Seymour Holtzman in April this year raising various claims of impropriety on the part of the company was "entirely without merit."

Holtzman claimed, among other things, that certain members of the company's top management may have improperly held parties at the company's expense, improperly contributed to the area's educational institutions and improperly used a company airplane, ONBANCorp said.
In response to Holtzman's demand, the board appointed a special committee consisting of independent, outside directors to investigate the claims.

The special committee, chaired by Henry Lavarnway, who also chairs ONBANCorp's audit committee, with the assistance of independent legal counsel, found no basis for any of Holtzman's claims, the company said.
At a meeting earlier today, the company's board of directors adopted the special committee's recommendations that no further action be taken in response to Holtzman's allegations.
